question: If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹40 and compound interest is ₹45, then what is the principal (in ₹)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

SI for 1 year = ₹40 ÷ 2 = ₹20.

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = ₹45 − ₹40 = ₹5.

This difference of ₹5 is the interest generated on the 1st year's SI.

Rate (R) = (Difference ÷ 1st year SI) × 100 = (5 ÷ 20) × 100 = 25%.

Principal (P) = (1st year SI × 100) ÷ R = (20 × 100) ÷ 25 = ₹80.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time (T) = 2 years, Simple Interest (SI) = ₹40, Compound Interest (CI) = ₹45.

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

For 2 years, CI − SI = P × (R ÷ 100)²

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI for 2 years = (P × R × 2) ÷ 100 = 40

⇒ (P × R) ÷ 100 = 20 ... (Equation 1)

⇒ Difference in interests for 2 years (CI − SI) = 45 − 40 = 5

⇒ P × (R ÷ 100)² = 5

⇒ [ (P × R) ÷ 100 ] × (R ÷ 100) = 5

⇒ Substituting Equation 1 into the above relationship:

⇒ 20 × (R ÷ 100) = 5

⇒ R = (5 × 100) ÷ 20 = 25%

⇒ Now, substituting R = 25% back into Equation 1:

⇒ (P × 25) ÷ 100 = 20

⇒ P × (1 ÷ 4) = 20

⇒ P = 20 × 4 = ₹80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

For a principal P and rate R% for 2 years, Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Difference between CI and SI for 3 years

For a principal P and rate R% for 3 years, Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)² × [(R ÷ 100) + 3].

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the effective rate becomes (R ÷ 2) and the number of periods becomes (2T).

Rule of 72

A quick mental math trick to estimate the time required to double an investment at a given compound interest rate: Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate.
